description: React functional component for managing a list of useful links, including fetching, displaying, editing, adding, deleting, and reordering links with backend synchronization and role-based access control.

classes.name: UsefulLinksManagement
classes.description: React functional component for managing useful links with fetch, add, edit, delete, reorder functionalities and role-based access control.

methods.name: fetchUsefulLinks
methods.description: Fetches useful links data from backend and updates component state, handling both old and new data formats.

methods.name: saveLinksToBackend
methods.description: Saves the current links order and data to the backend and shows success or error notifications.

methods.name: handleAddLink
methods.description: Validates and adds a new link to the list, then saves to backend.

methods.name: handleEditLink
methods.description: Sets a link into edit mode for in-place editing.

methods.name: handleUpdateLink
methods.description: Validates and updates an edited link, then saves to backend.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Deletes a link from the list and updates backend.

methods.name: setCurrentLink
methods.description: Opens a link in a new browser tab.

methods.name: handleStartRearranging
methods.description: Enables reorder mode and keeps a copy of original order.

methods.name: handleCancelRearranging
methods.description: Reverts links to original order if cancel is clicked.

methods.name: handleSaveRearranging
methods.description: Saves the new order of links to backend.

methods.name: handleMoveUp
methods.description: Moves a link up in the list.

methods.name: handleMoveDown
methods.description: Moves a link down in the list.
